skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the theoretical foundations and practical applications of economics in studying and resolving the interrelationship between economic development and environmental protection.
Understand economic tools and policies for managing the environment, and evaluate the economic value of natural resources and the environment.
Apply knowledge from the course to analyze economic content in practical environmental management.
Develop the ability to work independently and in groups, taking responsibility for choosing topics and solving basic issues in environmental economics in practical management.
Develop the ability to critically analyze and discuss economic environmental issues.
Develop the ability to solve problems related to environmental economics.
Develop research and analytical skills in the context of environmental management.
Develop the ability to communicate effectively in the context of environmental economics.
